nodes.rationale: The development-frozen selection passed guardrails and achieves MAE 719.6 MW on 8,759 matched hours. Cold-weighted MAE is 744.7 MW. Incremental cold improvement over the prior assisted policy is not established because its paired interval crosses zero.

nodes.label: Separate quantile and calibration policies with inadequate cold coverage
nodes.rationale: Native central/asymmetric and fixed engineered CQR intervals are distinct policies. Overall-WIS selection lacks a cold-tail guardrail. Exact CRPS applies only to a specified empirical residual distribution, not the sparse native quantile grid; fixed weighted-comparator conditional-quantile semantics remain limited.

nodes.label: Retrospective RTE availability, calibration and business boundaries
nodes.rationale: Use assumed pre-noon RTE D1 at 11:00 Europe/Paris, no D2/05:00 rule. National truth is shared across input views. Calibration ends before June 30, 2025 and has zero cold evenings; the previously inspected 2025–26 test requires future confirmation. No production/procurement implementation or euro savings is claimed.
